page_title: ANG 2-0 AUX | Angers v Auxerre 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Stephanie Frappart is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Angers quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+4' Superb touch by Bamba Dieng (Angers) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save! The ball goes behind for a corner. Angers will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Ange Loic N'Gatta (Auxerre) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' Dangerous play by Ange Loic N'Gatta (Auxerre). Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Angers, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
87' Gaetan Perrin will be replaced by Aristide Zossou (Auxerre).
84' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Bamba Dieng (Angers) replacing Himad Abdelli.
84' A substitution has been made. Ki-Jana Hoever is replaced by Ange Loic N'Gatta (Auxerre).
83' Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
81' Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Stephanie Frappart has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Angers have a free kick.
77' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Jean-Eudes Aholou will be replaced by Pierrick Capelle (Angers).
76' Florian Aye (Auxerre) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lassine Sinayoko.
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hamed Junior Traore will be replaced by Ado Onaiwu (Auxerre).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Assane Diousse (Auxerre) will replace Elisha Owusu.
75' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to substitute Jim Allevinah and he is replaced by Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) replaces Farid El Melali.
71' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the left side of the target, but Yahia Fofana keeps it out with an amazing save.
68' Yahia Fofana stretches to his right and makes a brilliant save! Gideon Mensah (Auxerre) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper into the bottom left corner.
68' Elisha Owusu (Auxerre) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

63' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul. Angers are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
60' Jim Allevinah (Angers) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
60' Jim Allevinah (Angers) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

60' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Donovan Leon sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
59' Angers take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

59' What a chance! Jim Allevinah (Angers) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance. The referee signals a corner kick to Angers.
54' A wild effort from Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.

53' Himad Abdelli (Angers) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Donovan Leon tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.

47' 2 - 0 Goal! Florent Hanin manages to prod the ball to Esteban Lepaul (Angers) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the right side of the goal. 2:0.
46' The game is over for Emmanuel Biumla. Abdoulaye Bamba (Angers) comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Stephanie Frappart has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+2' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) swings it in and Lassine Sinayoko gets on the end of it, but Yahia Fofana shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
42' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle after Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. There is a free kick near the sideline to Auxerre.
39' A raking crossfield pass from Carlens Arcus (Angers) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.
35' Jim Allevinah (Angers) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.

35' Lassine Sinayoko (Auxerre) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Yahia Fofana thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
30' Farid El Melali (Angers) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.

24' Jordan Lefort (Angers) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His rocket of a shot crashes against the crossbar! What a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Auxerre.
24' Jordan Lefort (Angers) will take the free kick.
23' A VAR review has confirmed the red card for Gabriel Osho (Auxerre).

23' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Gabriel Osho (Auxerre), but referee Stephanie Frappart must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
22' Gabriel Osho (Auxerre) makes a horrible challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!

22' Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle. Auxerre are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
18' 1 - 0 Sinaly Diomande (Auxerre) attempts to head the ball away from inside the six-yard box, but unluckily he turns a cross from the resulting corner into the top right corner of his own net.
18' Farid El Melali (Angers) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
14' Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
14' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle. Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) commits a foul after dangerous play.
14' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
12' It seemed like Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
10' Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
8' The resulting corner, taken by Gaetan Perrin (Auxerre), comes to nothing.

7' Ki-Jana Hoever (Auxerre) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Auxerre will take a corner kick.
7' A pass from Carlens Arcus (Angers) is intercepted by Donovan Leon and the move breaks down.
3' Hamed Junior Traore (Auxerre) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Angers will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Stephanie Frappart.
